items.statement: Bug QL-4471 in quartzlane was caused by two ingest workers claiming the same batch.
items.verbatim_anchor: two workers were grabbing the same batch off the ingest queue

items.statement: The user chose a content-hash dedupe key for quartzlane ingest instead of lock-based fixes.
items.verbatim_anchor: let's go with a content hash as the dedupe key

items.statement: After the dedupe fix, duplicate rows in the quartzlane replay run dropped from roughly three percent to none.
items.verbatim_anchor: duplicates went from about three percent to zero on the replay run

items.statement: The user mused that the quartzlane replay harness could become its own standalone library.
items.verbatim_anchor: the replay harness could honestly be its own little library

items.statement: Casper Hale said he can review the quartzlane queue rewrite next Tuesday.
items.verbatim_anchor: Casper said he can review the queue rewrite next Tuesday

items.statement: The user felt intense relief once QL-4471 was finally understood after a week of dread.
items.verbatim_anchor: I have been dreading this bug all week and now I feel ten pounds lighter

items.statement: The user noted they should backport the QL-4471 fix to the quartzlane v3 branch before Friday.
items.verbatim_anchor: backport it to the v3 branch before Friday

items.statement: The quartzlane replay harness processes the full August event log in about a minute and a half.
items.verbatim_anchor: the whole August event log replays in about ninety seconds

items.statement: The user thinks they should write up QL-4471 as a postmortem on the quartzlane wiki.
items.verbatim_anchor: I should write this up as a postmortem on the quartzlane wiki

distractors.anchor: CI was crawling this morning for no obvious reason
refilling my coffee before we dig back into the queue logs

hazards.anchor: I hear you on advisory locks but I want the hash approach
